inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL natural-language FULLTEXT query filters indexed text columns with MATCH ... AGAINST.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored bounded harbor search. MATCH ... AGAINST filters indexed notes, a stable identifier order makes the page deterministic, and LIMIT returns only the first two matching notes; the source schema, rows, terms, and application context are new.

fixture_notes: Three notes match the fixed harbor beacon phrase and one does not; the ordered query returns only matching note IDs 801 and 802 on the first page.
determinism_notes: Note IDs, text, search terms, ORDER BY, and LIMIT are fixed; the fixture has no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules.
setup: CREATE TABLE harbor_search (note_id INT PRIMARY KEY, note_title VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, note_body TEXT NOT NULL, FULLTEXT KEY ft_harbor_search (note_title, note_body)) ENGINE=InnoDB

INSERT INTO harbor_search VALUES (801, 'Beacon ledger', 'Harbor beacon marks the north channel.'), (802, 'Beacon repair', 'Harbor beacon needs a new lens.'), (803, 'Beacon watch', 'Harbor beacon is visible from the pier.'), (804, 'Garden log', 'Copper labels mark seedlings behind the greenhouse.')

steps.sql: SELECT note_id, note_title FROM harbor_search WHERE MATCH(note_title, note_body) AGAINST ('harbor beacon') ORDER BY note_id LIMIT 2
